verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Shortwave offering user controls over data retention or deletion of synced email or AI data. The only related mention is a community user who can delete their Shortwave account to switch back to Gmail; it does not show that synced server data is purged or that retention is configurable. Another user wished for a denylist to keep sensitive mail from syncing, implying no such control exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
